name: Thundering Wihsaak (Heretical)

items.name: Easy to Call
items.text: A sahkil's level is considered 2 lower for the purpose of being conjured by the Binding Circle ritual (and potentially other rituals, at the GM's discretion), but it is always free to attack or leave instead of negotiate unless the primary caster's check is a critical success.

items.name: Swarmwalker
items.text: Swarms of animals and other unintelligent creatures instinctively leave a wihsaak alone. A wihsaak is immune to the damage from and effects of swarms with an Intelligence of -5.

items.name: Abjure the Blessings of Vitality
items.text: Despite not being undead, this creature gains void healing. Its Strikes deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage to creatures that can cast divine or primal spells.

rules.label: Target can cast divine or primal spells

items.name: Droning Distraction
items.text:
Effect The wihsaak beats its wings rapidly, creating a buzzing drone that numbs creatures' minds. Each creature within 100 feet must attempt a DC 23 Will save save. They are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

---

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Confused and Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1 round and Stupefied 2 for 1 minute.

items.name: Skip Between
items.text:
The wihsaak moves from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice-versa, with the effects of Ethereal Jaunt except that the effect has an unlimited duration and can be Dismissed.

A summoned sakhil can't use Skip Between.

text:
The monsters have a visceral hatred of good deities and their servants, particularly Arcadia's benevolent couatls.

---

These gaunt and insectile sahkils torment their foes by focusing on a widespread fear of insects and creeping, crawling vermin. Unlike their more subtle cousins, wihsaaks don't lurk in the periphery and instead directly engage their targets, using their unnerving buzzing to disorient and terrify.

When encountering multiple foes, wihsaaks attempt to spread fear to everyone before slashing at them with their devastating claws.
